about: P3's kernel census on the laptop's Windows, one untimed job (paper/laptop_w/census_host.py at e886724). Read-only on the host; about a minute.

jobs.run_label: P3's kernel census on the laptop's Windows (untimed, descriptive, decides nothing): the gated Release oneport of p3-gate-w-5 started with no client and no load, IOCP one-port and dedicated; netstat counts its listening sockets, checked against GetExtendedTcpTable
jobs.note: read-only on the host: builds nothing, installs nothing, changes no setting, no wjob.py and no plan switch; the binary and gate are p3-gate-w-5's, which bound block 2b's rows (gate-W.json sha256 96248c8f, oneport eb810f4e); the collector refuses (exit 2) if either is missing or differs, or if a port is in an excluded range, and exits 3 if a row fails; standard library only, so the base Python; expected_s: no measured basis on the laptop (the desktop's functional run of this collector on the same binary, copied from p3-gate-w-5's archive, took 1.2 s; not a result); timeout_s: the collector's own caps give at most 161 s (two rows, each at most 15 s to its ready line, 0.2 s settle, 20 s for each of two netstat calls, 10 s to stop and 5 s to kill; 20 s for netsh)
jobs.plain: Ask Windows' kernel how many listening sockets P3's measured server opens in each layout, with no traffic
